# Meeticulous

> Meeticulous is an India-first appointment-booking platform for creators and professionals — coaches, tutors, consultants, designers, wellness practitioners and more (called "hosts"). Hosts publish services, share one short booking link, and get paid up-front — with 0% commission on paid plans. Guests book in seconds via OTP or a free account; payments run through Razorpay (UPI, cards, netbanking).

Key facts:

- **Plans:** Starter (free forever, 5% commission per paid booking) and Pro (₹399/month or ₹3,599/year, 0% commission). Prices in INR, GST included. A payment gateway fee of about 2.4% applies (Razorpay's, not Meeticulous's).
- **0% commission on Pro** — hosts keep what they earn, minus the gateway fee.
- **India-native:** INR pricing, GST invoicing and UPI built in.
- **Runs the whole booking:** payments up-front, email + WhatsApp reminders, two-way Google Calendar sync, and auto-generated video-call links.
- **Personal page:** every host gets `meeticulous.com/their-username` — a mini-site that books, bills and brands them.
- Positioned as a calmer, India-first alternative to tools like Topmate, Calendly, Setmore, Acuity, SimplyBook.me and Zoho Bookings.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://meeticulous.com/): What Meeticulous is — features, pricing and how booking works.
- [Pricing](https://meeticulous.com/pricing): Full plan comparison — Starter and Pro.
- [Explore](https://meeticulous.com/explore): Browse bookable services across professions.
- [Services directory](https://meeticulous.com/services): Services grouped by profession.
- [Become a host](https://meeticulous.com/become-a-host): Why and how to start taking bookings on Meeticulous.
- [Enterprise](https://meeticulous.com/enterprise): For teams, studios and larger practices.
- [About](https://meeticulous.com/about): The company, mission and the "calm economy" positioning.
- [Blog](https://meeticulous.com/blog): Product updates and guides.
- [Help](https://meeticulous.com/help): Common questions for hosts and guests, with a full article index at [/help/docs](https://meeticulous.com/help/docs).
- [Templates](https://meeticulous.com/templates): Free WhatsApp, SMS and email templates for service businesses (confirmations, reminders, payment follow-ups, cancellation policies), including Hindi.
- [Glossary](https://meeticulous.com/glossary): Plain-English definitions of booking and scheduling terms (buffer time, no-show, advance payment, UPI, GST invoice and more).
- [Tools](https://meeticulous.com/tools): Free calculators — no-show cost, GST on services, earnings by plan.

## Community

Real questions from Indian hosts and guests, answered by hosts and the Meeticulous team — pricing, payments, GST, no-shows, getting bookings, and running a service business. Threads carry accepted answers (Q&A / FAQ structured data).

- [Community home](https://meeticulous.com/community): Ask, share and learn with other hosts and guests.
- [Help & Questions](https://meeticulous.com/community/s/help): How-to questions from hosts and guests, with accepted answers.
- [Host Corner](https://meeticulous.com/community/s/host-corner): Business questions from hosts — pricing, growth and operations.
- [Community guidelines](https://meeticulous.com/community/guidelines): How the community works.

## Notes for crawlers

- Host profiles are public and live at `https://meeticulous.com/{username}`. The full, always-current list is in the [sitemap](https://meeticulous.com/sitemap.xml).
- Private app surfaces — host dashboard, admin, and sign-in/sign-up flows — are not intended for indexing or training (see [robots.txt](https://meeticulous.com/robots.txt)).
